method: Complete reading of three resource dictionaries; exact-commit Git blob hashes verified. Source-only, no rendered UI qualification.
findings: Profile card style enables previously reviewed HoverBorder behavior, uses fixed corner radius/padding, and enables layout rounding. This is a use site for existing hover lifecycle concerns, not a new runtime reproduction.

Checkbox template supplies explicit checked, disabled, focus and hover triggers. It has no indeterminate/null-state trigger, so a three-state checkbox would not receive a distinct mark from this template. Actual three-state use remains to be checked.

Checkbox ContentPresenter does not explicitly enable RecognizesAccessKey; caption mnemonic behavior is not established by this template. Focus visual is replaced with an explicit border-color trigger.
CustomTabControlStyle only sets background, thickness, margins and padding. It does not replace the TabControl template or define tab virtualization, navigation, or lifetime behavior.
No file-content comparison or hashing implementation is present in these styles.
limits: No WPF rendering, interaction, scaling or screen-reader test. No library production changes adopted.
